title.zh: 查询边缘转码模板详情

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口用于查询边缘转码模板详情。

- 用户需要具有访问边缘转码服务的权限，才能正常调用本接口。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为6000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to query the details of an edge transcoding template.

- You must have permissions to access the edge transcoding service to call this operation.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 6,000 calls per minute. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call the operation at a reasonable rate.
